description: Copy an S3 object to another location as a Dagster asset -- mirrors Airflow's S3CopyObjectOperator.

source_s3_url.label: Source S3 Url
source_s3_url.description: Source object as 's3://bucket/key'. Set this or source_bucket+source_key.

source_bucket.label: Source Bucket
source_bucket.description: Source bucket name. Set with source_key, or use source_s3_url instead.

source_key.label: Source Key
source_key.description: Source object key. Set with source_bucket, or use source_s3_url instead.

dest_s3_url.label: Dest S3 Url
dest_s3_url.description: Destination object as 's3://bucket/key'. Set this or dest_bucket+dest_key.

dest_bucket.label: Dest Bucket
dest_bucket.description: Destination bucket name. Set with dest_key, or use dest_s3_url instead.

dest_key.label: Dest Key
dest_key.description: Destination object key. Set with dest_bucket, or use dest_s3_url instead.

acl.label: Acl
acl.description: Canned ACL for the destination object (e.g. 'private', 'public-read', 'bucket-owner-full-control').

metadata_directive.label: Metadata Directive
metadata_directive.description: 'COPY' (default, keeps the source object's metadata) or 'REPLACE' (use this component's own metadata -- not yet exposed as a separate field; set via the python escape hatch if needed).

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Optional key of a registered aws_s3_resource. When set, credentials/session come from that resource instead of a bare boto3.client('s3', region_name=...).

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

name: S3CopyObjectAsset
